verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure that agents call through its API, SDKs, CLI and hosted MCP server. It has no agent runtime of its own that could consume tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this product type. Its documented hosted MCP server is the server role, which agents connect to; that does not make the MCP-client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
